risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- The statutory auditor (S. R. Rahalkar and Associates) drew attention in an 'Emphasis of Matter' paragraph to Notes 8.1 and 15.1, which state that Trade Payables and Trade Receivables balances are subject to confirmation. The auditor states 'Our opinion is not modified in respect of these matters', but the emphasis is a modifier the auditor personally raised: unconfirmed working-capital counterparty balances are a structural reliability concern around the largest current-asset and current-liability lines.
- Management flags that supply chain disruptions and dependency on key suppliers may impact production schedules; mitigated by strengthening supplier relationships and improving procurement planning.
- Fluctuations in steel and alloy prices continue to impact cost structures for a sheet-metal pressing business where input cost is the dominant cost line; managed through rate contracts, cost control measures and operational efficiencies.
- Machine breakdowns, tool maintenance challenges and manpower availability can impact productivity in a press-shop operation; addressed through preventive maintenance and process improvements.
- Changes in government policies and compliance requirements may affect operations; the Company states it adheres strictly to statutory norms and remains proactive in adapting to regulatory changes. Evidenced in practice by the two DGFT Show Cause Notices received in March 2026 relating to EPCG licenses.
- The Secretarial Audit Report recorded two observations: Show Cause Notices from the Assistant DGFT, Regional Authority Pune dated March 20, 2026 and March 25, 2026. The Company submitted documentation to surrender EPCG licenses 3130006550 and 3130006758, receiving the Non-Utilization Certificate on March 25, 2026 and the Letter of Surrender on April 7, 2026 — indicating export-obligation commitments under EPCG were not fulfilled.
- The Board's Report states the major risks have been identified and mitigation measures formulated in the areas of business, project execution, event, financial, human, environment and statutory compliance, under a Risk Assessment and Minimization Procedure reviewed by the Board.
- The Company operates in a single segment — automotive components and allied sheet metal products — leaving earnings tied to the domestic automotive cycle, only partly offset by growing contribution from the Electrical, Defense and Engineering segment.
